relations.product: collaboration giving users of Synopsys' Ansys HFSS (electromagnetic) and Ansys Icepak (thermal) simulation tools direct access to Murata simulation models for RF inductors, MLCCs and power inductors
relations.quote: Murata Manufacturing Co., Ltd. announces a new collaboration with Synopsys, Inc., enabling users of Synopsys' simulation tools to navigate directly to Murata's website to access and download the latest high-performance simulation models from Murata.
relations.label: Murata press release: Murata Collaborates with Synopsys to Provide Simulation (06-16-2026)

relations.product: business alliance agreement to develop new input interfaces (hand tracking, voice input); Melt Interface's ContactGlove3 Pro hand-tracking glove incorporates Murata's compact three-axis LF antenna
relations.quote: Murata Manufacturing Co., Ltd. (“Murata”) has signed a business alliance agreement with Melt Interface Technologies Inc. (“Melt Interface”) aimed at creating new input interfaces for the AI era.
relations.label: Murata press release: Murata Signs Business Alliance Agreement with Melt (09-28-2026)
